title: Ceci n'est pas une pipe -- Toward a Symbolic Solver for the Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus Using Evolutionary Computation
abstract: arXiv:2611.13831v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus (ARC) is a benchmark designed to assess the capability of Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems to generalize starting from a few samples, a task humans excel at. The ARC-AGI contests held since 2020 have been the focus of intense competition, with participants proposing approaches ranging from traditional symbolic AI to Transformer architectures. Despite a long history of successes, evolutionary algorithms (EAs) were notably absent from the approaches appearing in the main contest. As score-and-search program synthesis approaches, EAs suffer from issues related to choosing the proper representation in the Domain-Specific Language applied to the problem (for example, pixel-level or object-level), and distinguishing between two candidate solutions producing the same outputs. translated_title: 《此非烟斗——利用进化计算为抽象与推理语料库构建符号求解器》
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.13831v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：抽象与推理语料库（ARC）是一个旨在评估人工智能（AI）系统从少量样本出发进行泛化能力的基准测试，而这类任务正是人类所擅长的。自2020年以来举办的ARC-AGI竞赛一直是激烈角逐的焦点，参赛者提出的方法涵盖从传统符号AI到Transformer架构等多种途径。尽管进化算法（EA）有着悠久且成功的应用历史，但在主竞赛中出现的方法中却明显缺少进化算法的身影。作为“评分—搜索”式的程序合成方法，进化算法面临两类问题：一是在应用于该问题的领域特定语言中选择合适的表示方式（例如像素级或对象级）较为困难；二是难以区分产生相同输出的两个候选解。在这项工作中，我们提出了首个提交至ARC-AGI-2主竞赛的完全符号化的、基于进化的程序合成方法……
tldr: 该论文提出了首个提交至ARC-AGI-2主竞赛的完全符号化、基于进化计算的程序合成求解器，并着力解决进化算法在领域特定语言表示选择与等价候选解区分方面的固有难题。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first fully symbolic, evolution-based program synthesis solver submitted to the ARC-AGI-2 main competition, tackling the inherent challenges of evolutionary algorithms in choosing proper domain-specific language representations and distinguishing candidate solutions that produce identical outputs.
